title: I Married My Enemy—Then My Sister Sold Me Out
logline: A revenge bride publicly refuses to abandon her fake marriage, then learns the evidence she released against her enemy may actually frame her.
target_audience: US women ages 18-34 who binge dark-romance dramas, fake-marriage plots, revenge stories, and betrayal twists.
hook: She married the enemy to destroy his family. Their marriage was fake—but a shocking betrayal made her revenge dangerously real.
synopsis: Mara marries Adrian Vale to infiltrate and destroy his family, but he reveals that her sister sold him the plan. With seconds left, her sister admits the files will frame Mara—and says Adrian controls the only way to stop them.
